title: stillingia sylvatica var. genuina
intro: Stillingia sylvatica var. genuina, commonly known as King's American Plant or American Ipecac, is a plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family, native to North America. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing fever and relieving digestive issues. It is believed to exert therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, due to its bioactive constituents which include stillingine, saponins, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents present in this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, but further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and potential side effects.
